patterns.method: Group shared inputs while retaining complete binding differences
patterns.inputs: Exact material IDs, text, type/model, controls
patterns.sequence: shared asset -> compare full sets and task intent -> human confirms family
patterns.tradeoffs: Broad screens cover more but mix shots
patterns.failure_modes: Transitive shared-reference closure turns unrelated tasks into versions
patterns.applicability: Disclosed shared sources; never an automatic revision chain

patterns.sequence: group equal requests -> compare controls -> retain distinct candidates
patterns.failure_modes: Calling repetition a failure or independent trial
patterns.applicability: Candidate reruns only; seeds/controls may differ

patterns.method: Bind source, name changed properties and invariants
patterns.inputs: Actual source binding and correction instruction
patterns.sequence: source -> scoped change -> candidate -> explicit human review
patterns.tradeoffs: Scope must be interpreted; mechanism unknown
patterns.failure_modes: Inferring a defect, mask or preserved pixels
patterns.applicability: Named source-conditioned requests, without success claims

patterns.method: Use explicit producer/input pair plus named changed paths/spans
patterns.inputs: Original and consumer requests with source provenance
patterns.sequence: trace pair -> compare text/input/model/raw controls -> record intended delta
patterns.tradeoffs: Lineage includes preparation rather than revisions
patterns.failure_modes: Length growth becomes specificity or a different model becomes changed creative direction
patterns.applicability: Scoped case histories, no corpus semantic prevalence

patterns.method: Preserve literal model differences on named comparable members
patterns.inputs: Actual common inputs and primary text plus literal models
patterns.sequence: compare member bindings -> expose model/control deltas -> human choice
patterns.tradeoffs: Different interfaces and task context limit comparison
patterns.failure_modes: Inferring a preferred model, provider or improvement
patterns.applicability: Observed model differences; no benefit estimate

patterns.method: Record further-work edge independently of review decision
patterns.inputs: Explicit material consumer and scoped actor/version event
patterns.sequence: candidate -> observed further-work use; human review -> optional approval
patterns.failure_modes: Use approves a candidate; no use rejects it
patterns.applicability: Review contract to validate in Study 12
